dataRoles.name: content
dataRoles.description: Primary measure. Returns HTML (legacy KPI/HTML mode) OR a numeric value (chart mode + new primitive mode).

dataRoles.name: secondary
dataRoles.description: Phase 5.2: optional second measure. Used by stacked/grouped bars, line+secondary, scatter, bubble. Maps to _val2 in the primitive runtime.

dataRoles.name: tertiary
dataRoles.description: Phase 5.2: optional third measure. Used by bubble (size dimension). Maps to _val3 in the primitive runtime.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional. Bind a category/date column for chart mode and primitive mode.

dataRoles.name: category2
dataRoles.description: Optional second dimension column. Used by table visual for multi-dimension display.

dataRoles.name: category3
dataRoles.description: Optional third dimension column. Used by table visual for multi-dimension display.

dataRoles.name: category4
dataRoles.description: Optional fourth dimension column. Used by table visual for multi-dimension display.

dataRoles.name: category5
dataRoles.description: Optional fifth dimension column. Used by table visual for multi-dimension display.

dataRoles.name: category6
dataRoles.description: Optional sixth dimension column. Used by table visual for multi-dimension display.

primitiveSpec.description: JSON-encoded spec describing the visual type (bar/line/donut/etc.) + config (colorScheme, smooth, stacked, etc.). Set by the Semantica publish flow; consumed by the renderer to compose the chart via the same primitives runtime as the web app.
